title: Grendel/Prime
extract:
Release Date: October 18th, 2023
 Grendel Prime is the Primed variant of  Grendel, sporting bonus Armor and Energy, as well as an additional  polarity. Grendel Prime was released alongside  Zylok Prime and  Masseter Prime.

Acquisition

Crafting

Notes
 Grendel Prime, compared to  Grendel:
Higher Armor (400 vs. 370)
Higher Energy (200/250 vs. 190/240)
Higher Starting Energy (115 vs. 100)
Additional  polarity ( vs. )
When Grendel Prime wields his signature  Masseter/ Masseter Prime, he will become immune to crowd-control effects while performing Heavy Attacks.
As with any other Prime Warframe, moving close to the location of an Orokin Void Death Orb will restore a pulse of 250 Energy to nearby allies, even if that Death Orb is inactive, destroyed, or non-present. This effect can only occur once per orb.

Trivia
In his Prime Access trailer there are red suited Corpus wielding the  Flux Rifle, though no such enemy exists in game.
